BiblicalUsage: The word is a rising, and the psalm uses it of the sea itself: Thou rulest the raging of the sea, when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them. The rising waves are the picture of strength God rules.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the rising sea is no match for the Lord who stills it, and every wave that rises against His people answers to Him.
